federal_distinct_instruments: United States citizenship/naturalization and national admission status
United States armed-forces and national foreign relations
The federal treasury, federal debt and specifically federal taxes
Federal program entitlements as specifically defined
exclusive_scope_warning: These are distinct instruments/authorities, not a claim that every related broad subject has no state/local aspect. Do not label all health, education, disaster response, energy, immigration-related services or financial regulation exclusively federal.
coverage_limit: This is an extensible first hierarchy of recurring federal questions, not every CRS subject, all federal law, full program entitlements or a set of probabilities. Exact current rates, coverage rules, delegation and treaty procedures are separate profiles. Historical SSA and FEMA references establish program distinctions, not unverified 2026 amounts or eligibility.
catalogue_boundary: Use the existing pack namespace and registration/reporting. Preserve the loaded state/local 13-domain/127-issue identity; the earlier proposed 14/92 crosswalk remains nonblocking. Do not switch to a third state/local taxonomy.
implementation_input: No propositions are invented by this research to force a count. Existing modular provision/position definitions may reference these issues; generate actual terms through existing supported mechanisms and bind belief/effects to those actual terms.
